I have only 0.05 hectares for maize, so I must make do with what my family has. I will go to the cooperative and try to get some urea and DAP, though it may come late; even a little will help this tired soil, and I will also spread cow manure from our animals. I cannot afford improved seed from the market, so I will plant the local seed I saved from last year's harvest, and I will not waste money on chemicals for insects because maize here does not usually suffer badly. The rains will have to be enough because we have no way to irrigate, and since the plot is small, my children and I can do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without hiring anyone.
